title: TurnResource

prompt_cache_options.description: Prompt cache lifetime selected when this turn started, including an inherited session TTL. Null when the turn used the model default or no TTL was recorded.

session_id.description: The ID of the session that owns the turn.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent that ran the turn.

subagent_id.description: The ID of the subagent that ran the turn, if applicable.

status.description: The current status of the turn.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, used to order the turn by creation time. Subagent turns use their start time, falling back to completion time or the subagent opening time when the preceding timestamps are unavailable.

started_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the turn started.

completed_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the turn reached a terminal state.

error.description: A customer-safe error. Non-null only for a failed turn.

usage.description: Best-effort token usage for the turn, or null if unknown. Recorded usage may change.

description: The canonical public representation of a session turn.
